system.summary: Pranav Antal exploited, 8% · reinforcement 0, undermining 9 · also Li Yong-Rui

suggestions.how: Murder ships or crew of the controlling power or local factions here; system authority ships don't count.
suggestions.name: Crimes

suggestions.how: Sell goods worth 500 cr a ton or less here (hydrogen fuel and limpets work); the market must list them, and cheaper is better.
suggestions.name: Flood markets

suggestions.how: Hack the holo-adverts at starports here with a recon limpet. Illegal, and it hurts your standing with the station's owner.
suggestions.name: Holoscreen hacking

suggestions.how: Download power classified data from settlements here; hand it in at one of your power's systems.
suggestions.name: Power classified data

suggestions.how: Download power association and political data from settlements here; hand it in at one of your power's systems.
suggestions.name: Power political data

suggestions.how: Download power research and industrial data from settlements here; hand it in at one of your power's systems.
suggestions.name: Power research data

suggestions.how: Do Support missions from stations here; cargo donations count most.
suggestions.name: Support missions

suggestions.how: Collect salvage here and hand it to a Power Contact in one of your power's systems.
suggestions.name: Salvage
suggestions.uncertain: The wiki doesn't say where to hand it in; the refcard says any of your power's systems.

suggestions.how: Destroy the controlling power's ships here; other underminers' ships don't count.
suggestions.name: Power kills

suggestions.how: Open the locked power containers at settlements here and take the goods to a Power Contact in one of your power's systems.
suggestions.name: Retrieve power goods

suggestions.how: Scan the ship log uplinks of megaships here with a data link scanner.
suggestions.name: Scan datalinks

suggestions.how: Mine here and sell what you mined at a station here.
suggestions.name: Mine and sell

suggestions.how: Pick up Sirius Corporate Contracts from the Power Contact in one of your strongholds and deliver it to the Power Contact here. Other powers' agents may attack you.
suggestions.name: Power commodities

suggestions.how: Get tracker malware from a Power Contact and upload it to settlement data ports here, one per port.
suggestions.name: Upload power malware
